paragraphs: EnergyHub sells utilities software for building virtual power plants, helping them scale VPPs to manage load growth and renewables. The resources involved are customer-side devices such as connected thermostats, solar and storage systems, and electric vehicles.

A single platform holds all of a utility's distributed energy resources. Control runs year-round and across resource types, based on price signals and customer rates. The stated aims are to relieve congestion, protect assets, and defer infrastructure investments. The company also points to a deep partner ecosystem behind the platform.

EnergyHub says it has been delivering load control programs since 2009. One customer story describes work with National Grid on a pay-for-performance residential battery program in Massachusetts. Another describes a thermostat demand response program with Ontario's Independent Electricity System Operator to reduce peak summer load. That program enrolled more than 100,000 homes within six months. EnergyHub is an independent subsidiary of Alarm.com, listed on Nasdaq as ALRM. A newsroom item reports its acquisition of Resideo Grid Services.

quote.text: EnergyHub enables utilities to harness millions of distributed energy resources to meet the grid needs of a cleaner, more reliable power system.
